content.text: The cloned `data` repo implements Traceability static validation in Airflow DAG `traceability_static_validations_checker` via `TraceabilityStaticValidationOperator`, which downloads from GCS and runs `StaticValidationEngine` with `TraceabilityStaticValidator` and `TraceabilityErrorReporter`, then updates file status and branches to `traceability_excel_conversion` or `traceability_segment`. The cloned `data-cloud-functions` repo already triggers that DAG from `composer_dag_trigger` for traceability templates and declares a `process_traceability_file` placeholder for future CF-side work. This ticket aligns those paths: relocate the heavy validation runtime into Cloud Functions/first-gen CF code (following the GeoJSON static-validation pattern in `main.py` for DB status and conditional DAG triggers), then thin or deprecate the Airflow-only validation DAG while preserving rollback parity. Evidence shows the DAG error-report CSV uses columns File, Field, Value, Issue, Suggestion—not Row, Column, Reason—so the written acceptance criteria needs reconciliation before sign-off.
01 — Implement traceability static validation in Cloud Functions (entrypoint + flow) (data-cloud-functions · large)

Replace or implement `process_traceability_file` in `data-cloud-functions` and route `segment_batch`/`traceability_excel` uploads through it after lightweight template validation (`process_excel_or_csv_file`). Mirror GeoJSON orchestration from `run_geojson_static_validation`/success-handlers: set `staticValidationInProcess`/PASSED/FAILED on `DATA_FILES_TABLES_NAME`, attach error-report key on failure, call `composer2_airflow_rest_api.trigger_dag` for ingestion only when validation succeeds and triggers are permitted. Tune memory/timeout for 10MB/100MB/250MB envelopes.
Supplier-bucket uploads no longer enqueue `traceability_static_validations_checker` solely to perform static validation; CF performs equivalent checks

On success CF writes PASSED-equivalent status and triggers only the appropriate downstream Composer DAG (`traceability_excel_conversion` or `traceability_segment`) when `trigger_ingestion`/bucket rules permit
On failure CF writes FAILED-equivalent status, stores error report blob name/key, skips ingestion DAG
Measured wall times and configured memory satisfy the ticket targets or are justified with benchmarks
02 — Port static validation runtime from Composer DAG codebase into CF package (data-cloud-functions)

Reuse the logic embodied in `StaticValidationEngine`, `TraceabilityStaticValidator.run_validations` (mandatory/numeric checks via `MasterValidations.static_data_validations` plus Traceability-specific validators), and `variables/traceability_constants_v2.TraceabilityConstants` without Airflow imports. Decide copy-vs-shared-wheel layout under `composer_dag_trigger/traceability/` (parallel to `geolocation/`). Ensure pandas/read_excel/read_csv parity with DAG operator downloads.
Mandatory and numeric validation paths match DAG behavior for `.xlsx` and `.csv` inputs
Validators from `traceability_static_checker.py` execute in the same order and emit equivalent cell-level semantics
Airflow-dependent modules remain unused in deployed CF b
`data/src/composer/dag/static_validation/` pulls `MasterValidations` and traceability validators; refactoring is needed because Airflow-only imports (e.g. hooks, operators) must not leak into CF
Ticket performance and memory envelopes for large spreadsheets may conflict with synchronous CF execution limits without streaming or provisioning tuning
Rollback that keeps both DAG-based and CF validation in production risks logic drift unless shared code or parity tests enforce the \"< 5% gap\" threshold
Stakeholder-facing acceptance text (Row, Column, Reason) disagrees with `TRACEABILITY_CSV_COLUMNS` as implemented today
Should the CF-facing error CSV follow the literal ticket columns or the existing DAG contract `File`, `Field`, `Value`, `Issue`, `Suggestion` defined in `reporters.py`?

Ticket text says \"no external DB\" during CF validation yet GeoJSON CF code updates `public.data_files`; is Traceability supposed to omit DB writes, mirror GeoJSON (`DBHelper.db_value_update`), or differ by bucket?

After CF migration, does `segment_batch` / `traceability_excel` `CloudFunctionConstants.config` still point `dag_id` at `traceability_static_validations_checker`, or straight to ingestion DAG IDs with duplicated trigger payload semantics?
